# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/Oxyrine/Circe/issues/new) describing the
problem. There's no separate security inbox for this project — it's a hackathon
submission (Exasol AI + Data Challenge 2026), not a production service.

Include what you'd include for any bug report: the affected file/endpoint, steps
to reproduce, and what you'd expect to happen instead.

## Scope

- All data in this repository — entities, invoices, rings, scores — is
  **synthetic**, generated by `data/generate.py`. There is no real financial,
  personal, or proprietary data anywhere in this project.
- The public demo deployment (Vercel) serves a frozen, read-only export
  (`demo/data.js`); it has no database connection and no write path.
- The local/Exasol-backed path (`server.py`, `exasol/`) is intended for local
  development against your own Exasol Personal / Nano instance, not for
  exposure on the open internet. Don't run it as a public-facing service without
  hardening the audit/rescore endpoints yourself first (input validation is
  present, auth is not).

## Supported versions

This is a single-branch submission project — only `main` is supported. There
are no maintained older versions.
